sources.lesson: Trigger allocator reclamation when emitted-token progress crosses a threshold; speculative rounds can skip exact modulo values.
Speculative recurrent scratch is proportional to concurrently running requests, not every resident cache-capacity slot.
Do not retire recurrent state independently while a reusable attention-prefix boundary still refers to it.
A short final prefill chunk must publish recurrent state together with its exact logical sequence position.
Sparse global layer identifiers must not index storage allocated only by the number of participating layers.

mlx2_changes: Generation allocator cleanup preserves its 512-round cadence but uses monotone threshold crossing so a future multi-step counter cannot skip reclamation.
Qwen3.8 cache geometry exposes resident recurrent bytes separately from per-running-lane speculative rollback scratch.
CPU regressions pin APCv2 atomic hybrid target/draft retirement and forced final short-chunk recurrent checkpoint metadata.
Static audit found no mlx2 transfer buffer indexed by sparse global layer id; PLE residency remains identity tuples and QSA summaries remain keyed by explicit layer identity.
